messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finexcorp.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-20 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Possible data exposure via subprocessor bucket

Priya,

We just received an alert from our security team indicating a public-access misconfiguration on a subprocessor bucket used by one of our integrations. The initial investigation shows potentially identifiable user records (no SSNs observed yet) may have been accessible for a short window this morning.

Can you confirm whether Redwood or the listed subprocessor (EdgeStor, Inc.) holds any of FinexCorp's production data in that bucket, and whether Redwood will be initiating an incident notification under our DPA? We need:

- Confirmation of who controls the bucket and where the data lives
- Expected timeline for notification to affected customers
- Whether forensic logs and access lists can be produced for our auditors

Please treat this as urgent; our legal and compliance teams are standing by.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Head of Security, FinexCorp

Quick update from triage:

- EdgeStor was running a sync job hitting a misconfigured ACL that briefly opened a bucket (bucket: edge-uploads-finex-prod). We have an initial object inventory and a time window: 2026-11-20T07:40:00Z to 2026-11-20T07:55:00Z.
- Confirmed objects include payloads generated by Finex integrations (user_id, timestamp, model_result). No PII fields like SSN/credit_card were found in the object previews, but some profile email addresses and hashed user ids are present.
- We have read access logs from the EdgeStor control plane; attached a compressed export (forensic-logs-20261120.tar.gz). Also attaching a redline of the EdgeStor subproc clause we reviewed (subproc-contract-redline.pdf) and a checklist for evidence handoff (evidence-handover-checklist.xlsx).

Immediate actions taken:
- Temporarily disabled public-read on the bucket at 07:56Z and revoked the faulty sync job credentials.
- Snapshot taken and object list captured; stored in a locked internal folder with limited access.
- Started mapping object keys to Finex account IDs — will share mapping by EOD.

ETA:
- Mapping and initial export to Finex security: 2 hours (by 11:00 PST)
- Full log export and signed evidence package for auditors: 8 hours

Karthik
Sr. SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: forensic-logs-20261120.tar.gz, subproc-contract-redline.pdf, evidence-handover-checklist.xlsx

Subject: Re: Possible data exposure via subprocessor bucket — next steps and evidence delivery

Laura,

Thanks for flagging and for your patience. Summary and next steps below.

1) Ownership and scope
- Root cause: EdgeStor sync job misconfiguration opened bucket edge-uploads-finex-prod between 2026-11-20T07:40:00Z and 2026-11-20T07:55:00Z. Per our DPA and SOW, the data storage in that bucket is operated by EdgeStor (subprocessor) but Redwood coordinates evidence and notification under the subprocessor clauses.

2) Timeline for notifications
- Initial confirmation to Finex (this email): 2026-11-20T13:05:00-0800
- Detailed mapping of affected Finex objects (object keys -> account ids): by 2026-11-20T16:00:00-0800
- Formal notification package for auditors (signed, packaged logs + hash manifest): by 2026-11-21T03:00:00-0800 (we will escalate if auditors need earlier delivery)

3) Evidence we can share now
- Forensic logs export (see attachment): includes control-plane reads for the window
- Object inventory and object-level SHA256 manifest (attached in the evidence checklist)
- Subprocessor contract redline excerpt showing notification obligations

4) Cooperation and next steps
- We will: (a) provide the mapping and evidence package to Finex security, (b) run a joint review call if you want a walk-through, (c) follow the DPA notification obligations (72-hour contextual window unless legal advises otherwise).
- Please confirm whether Finex wants us to notify impacted end users directly or if you will coordinate end-user communications. If you choose Redwood to send notifications, we will need the customer-approved text and distribution list.

Attachments (sent to Finex via secure link): forensic-logs-20261120.tar.gz, subproc-contract-redline.pdf, evidence-handover-checklist.xlsx

I'll set up a brief call for 14:30 PST if that works — please advise.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference
